name: learn-while-building
description: Turn real project work into adaptive, practical lessons without interrupting the build.

interface.shortDescription: Learn from your own code while the agent builds it.
interface.longDescription: Adds a calm teaching layer to coding work: a 30-second summary first, project-grounded explanations, learning records, review questions, and optional offline HTML lessons.
capabilities: Adaptive explanations grounded in the active project
Project learning profiles and cross-session learning records
Offline interactive lesson generation with accessible visual fallbacks
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $learn-while-building to explain this project work as we build it, beginning with the 30-second summary.
